acceptance: The cache-stable-prefix guard of acs/cycle534 runs under the default go test ./... or under ./acs/regression/..., so a later cycle that breaks it fails CI.
acs/cycle534 keeps at most a thin call to the same assertion as its cycle evidence.
fix: Move the cycle534 prefix assertions into a package that CI runs every time (an external test package or acs/regression), keeping one home for the assertion.
summary: acs/cycle<N> packages build only under -tags acs, CI runs only ./acs/regression/... (ci.yml:69), and the audit lane runs only the current cycle package (acssuite.go:305-306). So the acs/cycle534 cache-stable-prefix guard ran once, in cycle 534, and never again: a later change that puts dynamic bytes above the boundary in a phase it covers fails nothing.
title: The cycle534 cache-stable-prefix guard runs in every CI run
